methodology.route_distance: OSRM driving route: primary central meeting point → secondary meeting point → safe route points → explicit return waypoints → primary meeting point.
methodology.meeting_minutes: Rounded OSRM driving time from the primary to the secondary meeting point.
methodology.full_map: Coordinate-based Google Maps directions URL, maximum 10 points; content-only points marked navigation_excluded are omitted.
methodology.coordinate_gate: Every safe point was checked against OSRM nearest-road. A point beyond 100 m is accepted only when an official visitor entrance is evidenced and the internal service road is absent from OSRM.
methodology.safety_boundary: Routing is a planning check, not a live opening/security/weather guarantee. Every WARNING remains visible and is checked again on departure day.

source_link_audit.method: HTTP GET with redirects and browser-style user agent against every unique official or institutional source URL.
source_link_audit.note: קישור 404 של מצודת כ״ח הוחלף בדף הישיר של מוזיאון הרעות. תגובות 403, אם קיימות, מתועדות כחסימת לקוח אוטומטי ולא כהצלחת HTTP.
